title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Tenure Relief on Late Charges
content:
A tenure relief applies to the late charge on a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements by the whole months from the agreement's effective date to the handling date: 15 percent at 36 months or more, 5 percent at 18 months or more but less than 36, and nothing under 18 months.

The effective date is read from the agreement record. The reliefs and any adjustment that apply to the late charge are first added into one share, and the charge is reduced once by that share; they do not act one after another, and the result is rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Tenure schedule

| Whole months from the effective date to the handling date | Tenure relief |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 15 percent |
| 18 to 35 | 5 percent |
| 17 or fewer | nothing |

## Hypothetical readings

| Effective date | Handling date | Whole months | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2023-04-12 | 2026-04-12 | 36 | 15 percent |
| 2023-04-12 | 2026-04-11 | 35 | 5 percent |
| 2024-10-12 | 2026-04-12 | 18 | 5 percent |
| 2024-10-12 | 2026-04-11 | 17 | nothing |

A charge of 30.00 USD with a tenure relief of 15 percent and nothing else applying is 25.50 USD.
